summary: The diff implements most requirements correctly. FloatingCallButton.tsx is created with the correct positioning, color, aria-label, click handler, long-press logic, tooltip, and drop shadow. Layout.tsx is updated to include FloatingCallButton on the left and FloatingWhatsAppButton on the right. One notable gap is the responsive button size: the spec requires 52px on mobile and 60px on desktop, but the inline style hardcodes 52px for both sizes without a media-query override for 60px on desktop. The 80px bottom clearance on mobile is also not explicitly enforced in either component.

missing_requirements.requirement: Button size should be 52px on mobile and 60px on desktop (responsive sizing).
missing_requirements.reason: The inline style sets width: 52px and height: 52px unconditionally for all screen sizes. There is no media-query or responsive override that increases the size to 60px on desktop. The Tailwind classes md:w-15 md:h-15 are present but are overridden by the inline style, so desktop size remains 52px.

missing_requirements.requirement: Both buttons must maintain at least 80px clearance from the bottom on mobile.
missing_requirements.reason: The FloatingCallButton is positioned at top:50%/translateY(-50%) which is fine for desktop, but no explicit bottom-safe-margin or media query is applied for mobile viewports to guarantee 80px clearance from the bottom navigation bar.

hallucinated_features.description: Visual press-down scale-95 animation on pointer down.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec does not mention a scale-down effect on press/pointerdown — only a scale-up hover effect is requested. The implementation adds a pressed state that shrinks the button, which was not part of the requirements.
